scope: Presentation-only new companion. Existing canonical share/archive/runtime/manifest/receipt bytes and codec remain unchanged; companion is not canonical decoder input, authentication, credentials, authority or source-currentness evidence.
pure_interface: public_text(raw: exact builtin bytes, budget: exact builtin int) -> exact builtin bytes; raise PublicShareError with exact reason on refusal.

cli.argv: python -I -S install/transport_public_share.py format INPUT OUTPUT --budget N
cli.budget: ASCII unsigned decimal token at most6digits, value1..131072; pure API also rejects bool.
cli.canonical_root: Normalized absolute INPUT.parent. OUTPUT must be strictly outside that entire tree. No following input/output-parent symlinks. Path UTF8<=4096bytes and <=65components.
order: PUBLIC_SHARE_CANONICAL_DESTINATION if output in canonical root
bounded complete write and success output
cli.writes: All text/size/budget validation occurs before output creation. Existing canonical root is read-only. Existing destination is never overwritten. A write failure removes only this invocation's own identified partial output when safely possible; I/O failure is explicit and no success is emitted. Caller must prevent concurrent filesystem mutation; no filesystem snapshot or atomic durability theorem is claimed.

pure_stage_order.rule: raw exact bytes; budget exact int notbool;1<=budget<=131072
strict UTF8 decode; no normalization or replacement
raw.rsplit(LF,2) exactly3parts with nonempty opaque display prefix and nonempty final reference; no trailing LF. Display prefix may contain earlier LF/STS1/CRED text and is preserved exactly.
Structural penultimate part exact ASCII STS1: followed by64lowercasehex, no spaces/CR/LF.
Final part exact ASCII attached:meaning.zip or legacy bounded HTTPS regex https://[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~:/?#\[\]@!$&'()*+,;=%-]{0,247}; fullmatch, no fetching.
Build prefix+LF+exactSTS1token+LF+CRED:sha256(exact ASCII STS1token bytes without LF)+LF+unchangedreference; complete UTF8 bytes<=131072.
Unicode codepoint length of complete companion<=budget, including all prefix/token/CRED/reference/newline characters; no dropping/truncation; no trailing LF appended.

resource_contract: Input/output individual bytecap131072, at most3 rsplit outputs, bounded input reader chunks16384 with fixed loopcount derived from cap; path components<=65, output write chunks16384 with fixed loopcount. No recursion, subprocess, dynamic source import, network, codec or decoder operations. Helpers<=60lines. Stdlib/OS/hash correctness and stable filesystem remain assumptions; no proof claim.
encoder_workflow: Pending owner choice before code. Formatter-only avoids executing caller-supplied source or adding a new qualified-encoder wrapper. Existing encoder command may be followed by this formatter using a new companion outside the canonical output directory; full companion budget is independently enforced.
implementation_gate: Independent exact-byte oracle frozen first, then implementation source, review and controls. No canonical package regeneration is authorized by this helper.
